written.myAnswer: Atmospheric pressure is balanced by the hydrostatic pressure of the mercury column: P_atm = ρgh.
Trapped air exerts pressure above the mercury column, reducing its height below the correct value.
Air entering through the leak reduces the height of the mercury column below its correct value.

Air molecules exert force on surfaces when they collide with them, so the atmosphere exerts force per unit area (pressure) in all directions. Examples include measuring atmospheric pressure with a barometer, estimating altitude from pressure, and demonstrating pressure when atmospheric pressure crushes a can after steam condenses.
